channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Judge rejects claims Trump religious commission was ideologically imbalanced
item.description: A federal judge dismissed a lawsuit challenging the makeup of Trump’s Religious Liberty Commission, ruling the president had broad appointment authority.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: city council] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Meet the candidates: Questionnaire for St. Petersburg City Council District 6
item.description: Leading up to the 2026 Florida primary (Aug. 18) and general election (Nov. 3), Tampa Bay 28 contacted qualified candidates for St. Petersburg City Council District 6.

item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Judge orders immigration officials to release key witness in Texas ICE shooting
item.description: A federal judge ordered ICE to release Jose Trinidad Rojas Pliego, a key witness in the fatal shooting of Houston homebuilder Lorenzo Araujo Salgado, citing Fifth Amendment due process violations.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Ballot lawsuit adds new twist to Wisconsin’s crowded governor primary
item.description: Early voting begins in Wisconsin’s turbulent Democratic governor primary as candidates battle for party unity and control of state government.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Pinellas woman inspires hope as treatment for rare disease is working; Moffitt expands options for patients
item.description: A Pinellas County woman is inspiring hope for rare cancer complication as her treatment is working. Moffitt Cancer Center is now expanding options for patients.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Florida could become first state in decades to carry out 2 executions in 1 day
item.description: Florida plans two executions in one day for the first time in decades, continuing Gov. Ron DeSantis’ sharp increase in use of the death penalty.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: hurricane] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] A Hug 1,393 Days in the Making: Hurricane Ian odyssey ends as Florida family moves into new home
item.description: Kaylee Sandin and her family spent nearly four years in temporary housing after Hurricane Ian destroyed their home before moving into a newly rebuilt house supported by community partners and recovery programs.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Sen. Lindsey Graham's foreign policy legacy shapes Washington diplomacy
item.description: Senator Lindsey Graham's foreign policy legacy shapes diplomacy as world leaders gather in Washington following his death.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Woman dies after falling from structure on Egmont Key: HCSO
item.description: A woman has died days after she was flown to a hospital following a fall from a structure on Egmont Key, according to the Hillsborough County Sheriff’s Office.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Washington sex offender wanted for 18 months arrested in Hernando County: HCSO
item.description: A convicted sex offender who had been wanted by authorities in Washington state for more than 18 months was arrested in Hernando County, according to the Hernando County Sheriff's Office.
